text:
sara_pm: morning — quick async product lifecycle check. TL;DR: finalizing owners for the next two roadmap slices (routing-cost and embed-cache). What I did: cleaned up the spec for routing-cost and added rollout constraints. Blockers: still waiting on quant eval numbers from infra (latency vs cost tradeoffs). Today: need design signoff for the UX changes and a final confirm on canary window. @maria_design can you review the tiny UX prototype by EOD? :pray:

omar_eng: shipped the model-pin API change to staging; added a feature flag `pin_v2` (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pin-service/pull/412). Smoke ran locally — kv cache behavior looks fine. Blocker: quantized 8-bit builds are flaky on one GPU type, repro attached in the PR. I can be oncall for the canary tomorrow morning.

li_engineer: reviewed the routing-cost spec — one comment on fallback costs math. Also pinging @omar_eng on the CR #412 for a quick perf regression check. My plan today: audit batch sizing defaults and push a small tweak to autoscaler config. No blockers on my side. :+1:

maria_design: looking now — small ask: move the routing toggle from the model page to a per-route settings panel so PMs can toggle on a route basis. That changes rollout UX slightly, but it lets us avoid surprise global toggles. I can mock up two variants and drop in Figma link by 3pm.

jen_prodops-bot: canary-deploy: routing-cost-canary started at 2024-06-15T09:12Z, target capacity 10%, region us-west-2. Logs: healthy -> 62 checks passed, 0 errors.

dave_research: quant evals: short update — 8-bit endpoints show a small drop on rare tokens in the poetry benchmark, but chat/general English looks fine. I'll push the full eval table to the shared folder; expect it by 2pm. Suggest we gate wide rollout on the evals plus an automated quality delta check.

sara_pm: thanks all. Next actions: @maria_design will post mockups, @dave_research will upload eval table, @omar_eng + @li_engineer will coordinate minor autoscaler tweak and CR merge plan. If all green, schedule canary expansion to 30% tomorrow 10am PST. If anyone sees perf regressions please ping here and tag @sre.

omar_eng: ACK — will open a follow-up PR to revert flag if we see regressions.

li_engineer: also leaving a quick note: I'll post the autoscaler config diff in #eng-infra for transparency.

maria_design: posted two mock variants in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/routing-toggle — preference for variant B which gives clearer per-route scope.

dave_research: eval table uploaded: https://storage.redwood.ai/evals/route-quant-20240615.csv — highlights in the doc. No major regressions beyond the poetry edge case.

sara_pm: great — unless objections, we'll proceed with canary expansion tomorrow. Closing this check-in. :rocket:
